params.prompt: Paint an ADULT HEROIC FANTASY RPG creature sheet matching the supplied approved painterly heroic style. Mature believable animal anatomy, small focused eyes, long functional limbs, broad sculpted forms, brush-painted fur/skin, dramatic directional light. NOT cute, NOT baby, NOT toy, NOT 3D kids cartoon, no plastic shine, no smile, NO oversized eyes or head. Restrained readable surfaces; no tiny decorative texture. Precisely FIVE distinct full-body creatures in 3 columns x2 rows, TOP3 and BOTTOM LEFT/CENTER; bottom RIGHT EMPTY. Each cell has 12% transparent clear margins, including paws, horns, tails and wings. Transparent RGBA background, no floor, scene, text or labels. Five ADULT creatures: 1 elephant, grey skin, normal small elephant eyes, long magnet-shaped trunk, sturdy long legs, restrained copper anklets; 2 adult sloth, long arms and coarse brown fur, ONE green sprout cap; 3 adult dugong, heavy realistic elongated body, small eyes, two foreflippers, teal palette and clear dew forehead shield; 4 emperor penguin, natural long torso and small eyes, restrained ceramic orange furnace panel on belly; 5 robust adult wombat, brown fur, barrel torso and single teal ceramic backplate.
